VoxaTrace/com.musicmuni.voxatrace.common.histogram.model/PeakData

PeakData

data class PeakData(val peakPositions: FloatArray, val peakAmplitudes: FloatArray, val valleyPositions: FloatArray, val valleyAmplitudes: FloatArray)

Peak and valley detection results. Domain-agnostic — positions can represent any x-coordinate system (cents, indices, time, etc.).

Parameters

peakPositions

X-coordinates of detected peaks

peakAmplitudes

Y-coordinates (amplitudes) of detected peaks

valleyPositions

X-coordinates of detected valleys

valleyAmplitudes

Y-coordinates of detected valleys
